en.hubeali: H 14732 - And from him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, who has said:
Abu Abdullahasws has said; ‘The government of the falsehood does not decline for a long time, and the government of the truth lasts for a short while’.
en.sarwar: 284. And from him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, who has said: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) has said;
‘The government of the falsehood does not decline for a long time, and the government of the truth lasts for a short while’.
